title: KRÜ deny blocking Less exit, blame payments stretching to 2028
content:
The Argentine club says it is the buyer, not KRÜ, who walked away from the table.

KRÜ Esports have denied refusing to sell Felipe “Less” Basso, saying in an official statement on 26 November that the only offer they received for the Brazilian spread its payments until 2028, beyond the end of his contract, and was withdrawn while the two sides were still talking. The statement came a day after THESPIKE Brasil reported that KRÜ had told MIBR there was no deal to be made.

The statement was published in Spanish on KRÜ’s website and X. In our translation, the club said:

KRÜ did not withdraw from any negotiation and at no point told another club that Less was not for sale, nor told the player that he could not leave the club. Our goal is to complete Less’s exit so that he can continue his career at the team of his choice, and we remain open to talks until an agreement is reached.

Comunicado Oficial Nuestra posición sobre la situación de Felipe "Less" Basso. 📰 https://t.co/RqMjOWbGhF pic.twitter.com/soWww17kQA

KRÜ do not name the interested club. MIBR are the team that reached a verbal agreement with Less on 13 November, as we reported at the time , and THESPIKE Brasil names them as the club behind the offer in its follow-up on the statement .

title: PUBG x IVE collab brings K-pop to online shooter
content:
PlayerUnknown’s Battlegrounds (PUBG) and PUBG Mobile are collaborating with K-pop group IVE to bring about original music and in-game cosmetics.

“The project will also introduce collaboration items across PC, mobile and console, with PUBG: BATTLEGROUNDS players on PC and console receiving themed in-game locations inspired by the project’s visual concepts,”

In terms of the release schedule for the collaboration, it arrives on Dec. 2 for PUBG players on PC. Then, PUBG Mobile players can check out the new items on Dec. 7 before the collaboration becomes available to PUBG players on console.

“The collaboration introduces a bolder, more confident creative direction for the group, offering a contrast to the softer, dreamlike atmosphere of its earlier ‘LOVE DIVE’ collaboration,” KRAFTON Inc., stated.

title: « Je crois vraiment en ce projet » : Boaster affiche ses ambitions chez Gentle Mates
content:
Présenté mercredi soir aux supporters de Gentle Mates lors de la traditionnelle Keynote du club, Jake « Boaster » Howlett s’est longuement confié à Sheep Esports sur sa nouvelle aventure. Après une saison 2026 particulièrement difficile chez Fnatic, le Britannique entend retrouver les sommets avec un roster qui s’annonce comme l’un des plus redoutables de la scène européenne. Et l’ancien capitaine de Fnatic ne compte pas se cacher derrière le statut de favori de sa nouvelle équipe.

« Je m’attends personnellement à ce que nous évoluions à un très haut niveau. Si ce n’est pas le cas, ce sera à nous, en tant qu’équipe et staff, de comprendre pourquoi. Je crois vraiment en ce projet et je ne pense pas que les choses puissent si mal tourner. VALORANT peut parfois être assez aléatoire, mais je pense que c’est mon tour de connaître une belle année. J’ai ce pressentiment » , a confié Boaster, visiblement satisfait des premiers entraînements de son équipe.

Boaster vu que tu parles français tu vas comprendre ça, on t’aime ! pic.twitter.com/6UF55H18CB

Après six années riches en émotions sous les couleurs de Fnatic, le Britannique ressentait le besoin de relever un nouveau défi. « C’était difficile, mais j’avais le sentiment que c’était le bon moment pour essayer un projet différent » , a-t-il expliqué. Séduit par le potentiel du roster et les infrastructures de Gentle Mates, Boaster n’a pas hésité à rejoindre la structure française, où il retrouvera notamment ses anciens coéquipiers Alfajer et MAGNUM, ainsi que l’entraîneur adjoint Desmo.

Le vétéran semble également particulièrement emballé par le potentiel de kozzy, le jeune prodige roumain de seulement 16 ans. « Kozzy a le talent d’une superstar à mes yeux. […] Il n’est pas là simplement parce qu’il est bon au jeu. Il a cette soif et cette passion » , a-t-il souligné. Boaster estime que Gentle Mates dispose de l’expérience et de l’environnement nécessaires pour accompagner le développement du jeune joueur, tout en lui laissant suffisamment de liberté pour exprimer son talent.

Ce changement d’équipe s’accompagnera également d’un changement de rôle pour le Britannique, qui délaissera les contrôleurs pour évoluer sur les initiateurs. Une décision notamment motivée par les opportunités du mercato et la volonté d’apporter davantage de puissance de feu à son équipe. Boaster estime également que ce repositionnement lui permettra d’être plus efficace dans ses fonctions de leader in-game.

title: LCK : Zeus se confie sur son grand retour chez T1
content:
C’est l’un des grands feuilletons de ce mercato qui a pris fin mercredi. Après deux saisons passées chez Hanwha Life Esports, Choi « Zeus » Woo-je a signé un contrat de trois ans avec T1, son club formateur. Lors d’une conférence de presse organisée pour officialiser son retour, le toplaner sud-coréen est notamment revenu sur les tensions qui avaient entouré son départ fin 2024, révélant avoir reçu de nombreuses excuses de la part du PDG de T1, Joe Marsh.

« Joe Marsh a reconnu ce qui s’était passé et s’est beaucoup excusé auprès de moi. Honnêtement, après quelque temps, je n’éprouvais plus vraiment de ressentiment. J’admire T1 depuis que je suis enfant. D’une certaine manière, c’est en regardant Faker que j’ai voulu devenir joueur professionnel. Ce n’était donc pas vraiment un obstacle pour moi » , a expliqué Zeus. Le joueur a également précisé qu’il souhaitait s’engager sur le long terme afin de s’épargner la pression mentale liée aux périodes de mercato.

Fort de son expérience chez Hanwha Life, où il a notamment remporté le MSI 2026, Zeus estime avoir considérablement élargi sa vision du jeu. « Deux ans, c’est court d’une certaine manière, mais cela a été long pour moi. J’ai l’impression d’être parti comme un gamin immature et de revenir en tant qu’adulte » , a-t-il confié. S’il ne nourrit pas de grandes inquiétudes concernant ses automatismes avec ses nouveaux coéquipiers, le Sud-Coréen entend aborder cette aventure comme s’il rejoignait une toute nouvelle équipe.

Cette conférence de presse a également été l’occasion pour Kim « Roach » Kang-hee, de retour après son service militaire, de s’exprimer sur sa nomination au poste de head coach. Conscient de l’immense pression qui accompagne cette fonction chez T1, l’ancien assistant de kkOma ne compte pas pour autant considérer ce poste comme un cadeau empoisonné. Avec un effectif composé de Zeus, Oner, Faker, Peyz et Keria, le nouveau coach aura la lourde tâche de ramener T1 au sommet après une saison 2026 sans le moindre trophée.

title: RLCS : même sans zen, Vitality affiche de grandes ambitions
content:
Une nouvelle ère s’ouvre chez Team Vitality. Après avoir perdu sa tête d’affiche Alexis « zen » Bernier au profit de Gentle Mates, la structure française a décidé de reconstruire son effectif Rocket League autour de nass, Oski et du jeune prodige brésilien diaz, âgé de seulement 18 ans. Si les regards sont principalement tournés vers l’impressionnant trio de M8, les Abeilles n’entendent pas jouer les seconds rôles cette saison.

Dans un entretien accordé à Insider Gaming , nass a toutefois reconnu que sa nouvelle équipe accusait un léger retard dans sa préparation. « Nous venons de commencer les scrims, donc je pense que nous sommes un peu en retard par rapport aux autres équipes, mais nous allons travailler dur en vue de Londres et enchaîner les heures » , a expliqué le joueur. Malgré ce manque de préparation, l’entente entre les trois joueurs semble déjà prometteuse.

À quelques semaines du premier grand rendez-vous international de la saison, prévu du 9 au 13 décembre à Londres, nass se montre particulièrement optimiste. « Je pense que nous serons de vrais prétendants pour Londres » , a-t-il assuré. Même son de cloche du côté de diaz, qui affiche des ambitions sans équivoque : « Pour moi, il faut tout gagner et représenter Vitality du mieux possible. Je pense que nous sommes une bonne équipe, nous avons de la chimie et nous allons bien faire. »

La confrontation avec Gentle Mates, désormais emmené par zen, Vatira et Atow, sera évidemment particulièrement attendue. Si M8 fait figure d’épouvantail sur le papier, Vitality dispose également de sérieux arguments pour rivaliser avec les meilleures formations de la planète. Le rendez-vous londonien permettra de mesurer le potentiel de ce nouveau trio, qui aura ensuite plusieurs mois pour monter en puissance et trouver ses automatismes.

title: Ubisoft Explains Why Rainbow Six Siege Esports Is Difficult for New Viewers
content:
Rainbow Six Siege is one of the most tactically demanding games in competitive esports. For newcomers, following a professional match can be overwhelming because of complex maps, destructible environments and constantly changing strategies.

During the Rainbow Six Siege Osaka Major in November 2026, Dot Esports interviewed Nelson Garcia, Ubisoft’s director of Rainbow Six esports live events and broadcast.

In the interview, published on November 26, Garcia explained how new spectators can better understand professional matches and why the live-event experience offers more than competitive gameplay.

Unlike Counter-Strike 2 or VALORANT, Rainbow Six Siege features extensive vertical gameplay and destructible environments.

Teams can attack objectives through floors, ceilings and walls, making player positioning difficult to follow.

Every round introduces different operator combinations, defensive setups and tactical approaches.

title: NiKo Reportedly Set to Lead Falcons as karrigan Faces Bench After Singapore Major
content:

He also temporarily handled calling responsibilities for G2 Esports during their successful IEM Dallas 2024 campaign.

title: Anthropic Briefly Lost Its $1 Trillion Value, Then Closed Back Above It
content:
A widely shared post on X on 25 November declared that Anthropic “is no longer worth $1 trillion”, less than a week after the company behind Claude made its stock market debut. The claim was true for part of Wednesday’s trading session, when the shares fell as low as $73.85. They then recovered to close at $82.79, which values the company at about $1.11 trillion using the share count in its final prospectus.

US stock markets are closed on 26 November for Thanksgiving, so that Wednesday close is the latest price. The swing still matters, because Anthropic has now closed below its $83 offering price twice in a row. For gaming, it is also the first real market test of a company whose models are already being used to build games, run AI squadmates and port old titles.

Anthropic priced its shares at $83 in a final prospectus dated 18 November, and they began trading on Nasdaq under the ticker ANT the next day. The offering raised $81.34 billion before costs, and a separate $26 billion private placement brought in Google, Nvidia, AMD, Broadcom, Micron, Microsoft and TSMC as investors at the same price. The stock opened at $111.50, touched $115.10 and closed its first day at $97.17.

The slide began within days of the debut, during a wider sell-off in technology stocks. The shares closed at $81.90 on 24 November, down 6.5 per cent and below the offering price for the first time. On 25 November they dropped to $73.85 at their low, about 11 per cent under $83 and 36 per cent below the debut high. A late recovery then left them at $82.79, according to Google Finance data.

Analysts quoted by City AM blamed poor timing amid a wider sell-off in technology stocks, and said the underwriters could not hold the price after exercising their option to buy extra shares on 20 November. Investors are also weighing a lock-up release that reportedly lets up to 303 million shares be sold from 15 December. Yahoo Finance reported that chief executive Dario Amodei and president Daniela Amodei each sold about $280 million of shares in the IPO, at the offering price. Anthropic has not commented on the share price.

Different outlets have put very different values on the same share price, so TalkEsport worked the numbers out from Anthropic’s own filing. The prospectus lists 7.73 billion Class A shares, including the underwriters’ extra shares, and 5.64 billion Class N shares after the offering. That makes about 13.37 billion shares in total, which puts the $1 trillion line at roughly $74.81 a share.

title: GTA 6 PC Port Running on 25 FPS Hits Russian Torrent Sites
content:
An unofficial PC version of GTA 6 has started circulating on Russian torrent sites, a week after the game launched on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Several Russian outlets reported on 26 November that a build said to come from a port project called CGBJ had been posted for download. Posts on X claim it runs at 25 to 30 frames per second, but nothing about the release is official, and the claims have not been independently tested.

One X post describing the build said the port had “officially” reached the torrent sites, which gives the wrong impression. Rockstar has not announced a PC version of GTA VI, and the official GTA VI site still lists the game for PS5 and Xbox Series X and S only. Every PC build in circulation depends on files taken from the Xbox version of the game.

Russian sports outlet Championat reported that a user posted the first build of the port to torrent trackers on 26 November. That was three days after hacking group Cyberleek leaked the executable needed to launch the game, according to the same report. Mail.ru’s Hi-Tech section reported the same release and said the CGBJ project’s GitHub repository disappeared less than an hour after it went public. TalkEsport has not downloaded the files and will not link to them.

The port builds on a leaked Xbox Series build that has been spreading since Cyberleek claimed the leak on 20 November. Within days, modders were saying the game was already booting on PC , and dozens of separate projects started racing to make it playable. A fan-run tracker now lists 39 such projects, according to a technical write-up on the Russian tech community site Habr.

The requirements quoted for the CGBJ build are steep. Mail.ru listed a Ryzen 5 3600 or Core i5-10400 processor, 32GB of RAM, a graphics card with 16GB of video memory and 209GB of SSD space. The size alone shows the download is the full game rather than a small patch, which matters for the legal questions around it.

The 25 to 30 frames per second figure comes from the projects themselves and the fan tracker that follows them. That tracker reports an average of about 25 frames per second in normal play and close to 30 indoors and in cutscenes. German outlet PC Games Hardware reported lower developer measurements, with a median of 17 to 18 frames per second.

title: AnyPS5 Passes 61,000 GitHub Stars as GTA 6 Fans Look for a Way Onto PC
content:
AnyPS5, an open-source project that converts PlayStation 5 games into native Windows and Linux programs, has become one of the most-watched repositories on GitHub in the week GTA 6 arrived on consoles. GitHub itself drew attention to it on 26 November, saying the project had passed 58,000 stars since its August launch. By the afternoon of the same day, the repository showed about 61,700 stars, roughly 6,000 forks and more than 1,100 contributors.

The surge is easy to explain, because GTA 6 is only available on PS5 and Xbox Series X and S. Rockstar has not announced a PC version, so many PC players are watching any project that promises to move console games onto their machines. The project’s own records show it is nowhere near running GTA 6, however, and even GTA 5 is still rough.

GTA 6 is finally here, sparking one of the biggest weeks in gaming and open source on GitHub. The repo AnyPS5 has passed 58K stars since its August launch, rewriting PS5 executables to run on Windows and Linux. Does changing where games run cross a legal line? Share your take.… pic.twitter.com/WY7i9pg1G0

AnyPS5 describes itself as a relinker rather than an emulator. It takes a PS5 game’s executable and converts it into the target system’s native format, then links it against its own reimplementations of the PS5’s system libraries. There is no separate runtime process imitating the console, which is the approach used by traditional emulators.

The project says it does not include or distribute any copyrighted software, firmware, keys or Sony libraries. Its documentation also says the tool does not extract or decrypt game files, and that it needs an executable that has already been decrypted. PS5 games are encrypted on the console, and a claimed game dump on firmware 14.22 this month showed how much effort goes into getting files off it.

The scale of the effort is unusual for a project of this kind. The repository passed 51,000 commits on 26 November and had about 2,400 open pull requests at the same time. It has a set of rules written specifically for AI coding agents, and every pull request has to state whether AI tools were used to make it.

title: 9z CEO Says CS2 Pros Are Discussing a Boycott of the Next Major
content:
Professional Counter-Strike players are discussing a possible boycott of the next Major, according to Francisco “Frankkaster” Postiglione, the chief executive of Argentine organisation 9z. He made the claim on X on 26 November, during the PGL Major Singapore, after saying that the money teams earn from Majors no longer covers the cost of the staff they send. No player, team or players’ group has confirmed any plan publicly, so at this stage it is talk reported by one team owner rather than an organised action.

Frankkaster’s first post went up at 01:54 UTC, hours before 9z played their final match of the event. Writing in Spanish, he said the Major situation was bordering on disastrous, because teams could not even cover the travel costs of the staff who support players and create content. His comments add a team owner’s voice to a complaint that has been building across the scene for most of the season.

Lo del major ya rosa lo nefasto, no llegas ni a cubrir al personal que viaja para asistir jugadores y crear contenido

The boycott claim came in a reply rather than in his original post. At 02:27 UTC, an X user named Alfonsina asked whether it was true that players wanted to organise and stay away from the next Major, adding a one-word call for them to unionise. Frankkaster answered at 04:39 UTC, and his reply is the only direct evidence so far that such a discussion exists.

In that reply, he wrote that “it’s happening”, and said the Argentina Major would be the event to suffer, which angered him most of all. He did not say which players or teams were involved, how many of them backed the idea, or whether anything had been put to Valve or the organisers. Skin-trading accounts on X then spread the exchange in English, describing it as a report that pros were discussing a boycott.

title: Gentle Mates : Vatira raconte les coulisses de la création de la superteam avec zen et Atow
content:
Présenté officiellement aux supporters de Gentle Mates mercredi soir lors de la traditionnelle Keynote du club, Axel « Vatira » Touret s’est longuement confié à Sheep Esports sur son choix de rejoindre M8. Après quatre années riches en émotions sous les couleurs de la Karmine Corp, le quadruple vainqueur de Major ressentait le besoin de tourner la page. La réputation de Gentle Mates, sa communauté et les infrastructures du club, notamment sa Gaming House, ont pesé dans la balance.

« Pour moi, c’était la fin d’un cycle. […] Ça a été très difficile parce que j’ai passé pratiquement toute ma carrière là-bas. J’y ai remporté tous mes grands titres et participé à tellement d’événements avec les supporters. J’aime cette organisation, donc oui, ça a été difficile » , a confié Vatira, qui retient notamment son sacre au Major de Paris en mai dernier comme son plus beau souvenir à la Karmine Corp.

Le roster THANOS est là ! pic.twitter.com/HZHuWfvAex

Si les trois grandes structures françaises se sont disputé les signatures de Vatira, zen et Atow durant l’intersaison, les trois joueurs étaient déterminés à évoluer ensemble, quitte à se passer d’une organisation. « Il n’y avait pas vraiment de plan B. Si nous n’avions pas pu monter cette équipe au sein d’une structure, nous l’aurions simplement fait sans structure. Nous voulions absolument jouer ensemble parce que nous savons que nous pouvons être la meilleure équipe. […] Nous aurions formé ce roster quoi qu’il arrive » , a révélé le Français.

Déjà proches en dehors du jeu, les trois joueurs n’ont visiblement pas rencontré de grandes difficultés à trouver leurs automatismes. Vatira avait notamment eu l’occasion d’évoluer avec zen lors de la FIFAe World Cup, tandis qu’Atow et l’ancien prodige de Vitality ont remporté ensemble les premiers championnats du monde de 2v2 en septembre dernier. Une complicité qui s’est rapidement traduite par un premier trophée lors de la Coupe de France, remportée par Gentle Mates en novembre.

Malgré son immense palmarès, Vatira court toujours après un premier titre de champion du monde. Et c’est précisément pour décrocher cette couronne que les trois monstres de la scène francophone ont décidé d’unir leurs forces. « Évidemment, nous voulons aussi remporter d’autres tournois, mais nous sommes tous ici pour gagner les championnats du monde. C’est ce dont les gens se souviendront » , a affirmé le nouveau joueur de Gentle Mates, désireux de marquer l’histoire du club.

title: PGL Major Singapour : le fiasco de FaZe Clan et s1mple…
content:
Le dernier Major de l’année 2026 tourne au cauchemar pour FaZe Clan. Engagée dès le premier tour de la compétition, la formation internationale n’aura remporté qu’une seule rencontre en trois jours. Battus d’entrée par Wildcard (9-13), dupreeh et ses coéquipiers avaient pourtant parfaitement réagi en écrasant GOSH (13-3), avant de rechuter face à PARIVISION (10-13). Dos au mur ce jeudi matin, FaZe n’est pas parvenu à sauver sa peau face à HEROIC.

Malgré une belle réaction sur Ancient, la formation internationale s’est inclinée en trois cartes (1-2), plombée notamment par ses difficultés en attaque sur Mirage et Nuke. Même frozen, meilleur joueur de son équipe sur l’ensemble de la série, n’a pas réussi à inverser la tendance sur la carte décisive. Éliminé avec un bilan d’une victoire pour trois défaites, FaZe termine à la 28-30e place du Major de Singapour. Une bien triste conclusion à une saison particulièrement décevante pour l’organisation.

Out of the Major pic.twitter.com/2Ya2ydpZqW

La désillusion est encore plus grande pour GOSH, nom sous lequel évolue BC.Game Esports à Singapour pour se conformer à la législation locale sur les jeux d’argent. Malgré la présence de deux anciens champions de Major, Oleksandr « s1mple » Kostyliev et Emil « Magisk » Reif, la formation internationale a complètement manqué son rendez-vous. Balayée par Team Liquid (1-13) puis FaZe Clan (3-13) lors de la première journée, elle jouait déjà sa survie mercredi face aux Mongols de Chinggis Warriors.

Alors qu’ils menaient 11-6 sur Ancient, s1mple et ses coéquipiers ont encaissé sept rounds consécutifs pour finalement s’incliner (11-13). Malgré une prestation exceptionnelle de Senzu sur Dust2 (13-6), avec 2.51 de rating, GOSH a définitivement rendu les armes sur Nuke (10-13). Un terrible fiasco pour ce projet ambitieux, qui quitte Singapour sur un bilan de trois défaites et une seule carte remportée. Avant même l’entrée en lice des grands favoris de la compétition, plusieurs des plus grandes légendes de Counter-Strike sont donc déjà sur le chemin du retour.

title: How To Fix The GTA VI Weather Bug and Bring Back Rain
content:
The GTA 6 weather bug keeps Leonida stuck on clear skies for long stretches, and players on PS5 and Xbox Series X|S still report it. Rockstar released update 01.002.002 on November 23 to fix weather that does not change for extended periods. Many players say the problem remains. A manual workaround is now spreading.

This guide covers the steps for both consoles, what the patch changed, and what to expect after you try the fix.

GTA 6 launched on November 19, 2026, for PS5 and Xbox Series X|S. Soon after, players said rain and storms rarely appeared. Weather did change for some of them, but far less often than intended, and some conditions lasted too long.

Rockstar responded with update 01.002.002 . Its patch notes say the update fixed an issue that stopped weather from changing for extended periods. Some players still see the same problem after installing it.

Clearing the system cache is the workaround players now use. Rockstar also provides its own support steps for clearing the Xbox cache.

Cache clearing does not remove your saves or inventory. On Xbox, Rockstar says the steps reset brightness and language settings.

title: LCS : Zven lâche FlyQuest pour OpTic Gaming
content:
Le mercato nord-américain vient de connaître un rebondissement pour le moins inattendu. Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Jesper « Zven » Svenningsen aurait décidé de revenir sur son accord verbal avec FlyQuest pour s’engager auprès d’OpTic Gaming. L’AD Carry danois de 29 ans avait pourtant donné son feu vert à FlyQuest à la mi-novembre, poussant la structure à mettre un terme à ses recherches pour ce poste. Mais l’arrivée tardive d’OpTic Gaming sur le marché des transferts aurait finalement changé la donne, le vétéran ayant accepté une nouvelle offre dans la soirée de mardi.

Ce revirement place FlyQuest dans une situation particulièrement délicate, alors que la majorité des AD Carry évoluant en LCS ont déjà trouvé leur point de chute pour 2027. Son ancien titulaire, Massu, devrait notamment poursuivre sa carrière chez Shopify Rebellion. La structure nord-américaine, qui comptait aligner Zamudo, Yukino, Hwichan, Zven et Cryogen, doit donc reprendre ses recherches à un stade déjà bien avancé du mercato. Une rupture d’accord verbal à l’initiative d’un joueur reste extrêmement rare au plus haut niveau de la scène compétitive.

Après six années passées chez Cloud9 en deux passages distincts, Zven devrait donc ouvrir un nouveau chapitre de sa carrière. Finaliste du Winter Split et demi-finaliste du Spring Split des LCS en 2026, le Danois avait été écarté du cinq titulaire à l’approche du Summer Split, au même titre qu’APA, à la suite des résultats décevants de Cloud9. Après plusieurs mois éloigné de la compétition, l’ancien joueur de G2 Esports s’apprête ainsi à retrouver une place de titulaire dans le championnat nord-américain.

De retour en LCS à la place de Dignitas, OpTic Gaming semble vouloir miser sur un mélange de jeunesse et d’expérience pour son nouveau projet. La structure aurait déjà trouvé des accords avec le jungler KryRa et le midlaner Toasty, deux jeunes talents désireux de s’imposer dans l’élite nord-américaine. Avec Zven, OpTic s’offrirait un joueur particulièrement expérimenté, capable d’encadrer ses jeunes recrues et d’endosser un rôle de leader au sein de cette nouvelle formation.

title: FaZe Crash Out of the Singapore Major at 1-3
content:

It is FaZe’s worst record at a Major since IEM Rio 2022, where the defending champions went 0-3 in the Legends Stage and finished 15th to 16th. This time the team never left the first stage, playing all four of its matches before the Major had reached its fourth day. FaZe started in Stage 1 because they were 20th in Valve’s global standings of 2 November , too low for a later invite on the Singapore Major schedule.

FaZe's run at the PGL Major Singapore 2026 ends here @heroicgg survive the 2-1 thriller to move to 2-2 and keep their Major alive. @FaZeEsports exit the tournament with a 1-3 record. #PGLMajor pic.twitter.com/wK4XIkNo96

FaZe picked Mirage for the first map and lost it 13-3, falling one map from elimination inside the first hour. They answered on HEROIC’s pick of Ancient, winning it 13-11, and the team’s account quickly posted that FaZe still had life .

Nuke, the map left over after both sides made their bans, ended the series in one direction. HEROIC won it 13-3, the same score as the opener, and FaZe managed only six rounds across the two maps they lost. HEROIC, who sat 18th in the same Valve standings, wasted little time on X and pointed FaZe towards the airport in a post minutes after the win.

It is not the first time HEROIC have ended a FaZe Major either, as they also beat FaZe 2-1 in the quarterfinals of the 2023 Paris Major. title: Falcons va écarter karrigan, NiKo prêt à prendre les commandes ?
content:
C’est une petite bombe à quelques jours de l’entrée en lice de Team Falcons au PGL Major de Singapour. Selon les informations dévoilées par le Français Sébastien « KRL » Perez, confirmées dans la foulée par HLTV , Finn « karrigan » Andersen devrait perdre sa place de titulaire à l’issue du tournoi. Nikola « NiKo » Kovač prendrait alors les commandes de la formation saoudienne à partir de 2027.

Arrivé en avril dernier, karrigan avait pourtant rapidement trouvé la recette du succès avec Falcons. Après deux finales au PGL Astana et aux CS Asia Championships, le Danois avait mené ses troupes jusqu’au sacre à l’IEM Cologne Major en juin, permettant notamment à NiKo de décrocher le premier Major de sa carrière. Mais la dynamique s’est depuis complètement inversée. Falcons n’a disputé aucune finale depuis la pause estivale, tandis que karrigan affiche un inquiétant rating moyen de 0,76 en 115 maps sous ses nouvelles couleurs.

À 29 ans, NiKo s’apprête ainsi à donner un nouveau tournant à sa carrière. Le Bosnien n’a jamais caché son intérêt pour le rôle de leader in-game, qu’il a déjà occupé chez FaZe Clan en 2019, justement après le départ de karrigan. Il avait également endossé cette responsabilité chez G2 Esports lors de l’épopée victorieuse de l’IEM Dallas 2024. Reste désormais à savoir si l’une des meilleures gâchettes de l’histoire de Counter-Strike parviendra à s’imposer durablement dans ce rôle.

En attendant, NiKo et karrigan auront une dernière occasion de briller ensemble à Singapour. Les champions du monde en titre feront leur entrée dans la compétition le 2 décembre, directement lors du Stage 3, avec l’ambition de conserver leur couronne. Un ultime défi pour le légendaire capitaine danois, alors que l’identité de son potentiel remplaçant au sein du cinq majeur reste encore inconnue.

Après seulement une année passée chez Bilibili Gaming, l’AD Carry sud-coréen devrait donc quitter la Chine, malgré les efforts déployés par les dirigeants de BLG pour conserver leur champion du monde.

Viper sort pourtant d’une saison exceptionnelle sous les couleurs de la formation chinoise, avec deux titres en LPL, un sacre au First Stand, une finale du MSI et surtout un deuxième titre de champion du monde. De retour en Corée du Sud après neuf années passées en Chine, Scout a quant à lui vécu une saison bien plus compliquée chez Nongshim RedForce. Libre depuis l’expiration de son contrat le 17 novembre dernier, le midlaner pourrait désormais relancer sa carrière aux côtés de son ancien partenaire, quatre ans après la fin de leur collaboration chez EDG.

Neuvième de la LCK en 2026 avec un bilan de sept victoires pour dix-neuf défaites, DRX a décidé de repartir de zéro en se séparant de l’intégralité de son cinq titulaire. title: Can you get rid of your Ultimate Edition bonus cars in GTA 6?
content:
The Ultimate Edition of Grand Theft Auto 6 proved to be the most popular edition of the record-breaking game, even though it costs $100 compared to the base $80. Many players simply couldn’t pass up on all of the content being offered with the Ultimate Edition in GTA 6, which is a long list.

However, while some of the Ultimate Edition content is nice, players are finding that other parts of it can be a nuisance. Specifically, the cars that come with the edition can easily be surpassed by other vehicles in GTA 6. Unfortunately, players are discovering that Ultimate Edition cars can’t be sold or unregistered, so what do you do with them once they’ve been claimed?

If you’re here, then you likely went to Moses or a Pay ‘n’ Spray shop in GTA 6 to register a new car, but saw you’re out of owned vehicle slots. In an attempt to free up space, you went to sell or unregister an Ultimate Edition car you redeemed, but saw a message saying you’re unable to do so.

Specifically, if you view a “Bonus Vehicle” like Jason’s ’55 Stanier or the ’67 Vapid Dominator Buggy, you’ll see a locked icon next to the vehicle and the message: “You can’t sell bonus vehicles.”

So, what do you do about all those bonus vehicles clogging up space in your garage? At the moment, it seems there is no way to actually get rid of them in GTA 6 . As soon as you claim a bonus vehicle from the Ultimate Edition or your pre-order, it becomes a permanently stored vehicle for the rest of your playthrough.

We even tried purposely losing or destroying some of these vehicles, but to no avail; they still wound up back in our stored vehicles tab at a Pay ‘n’ Spray. Right now, this seems to be an oversight by Rockstar Games, as there are too few precious stored vehicle slots in GTA 6 for them to be taken up by vehicles that have no use.

title: Aion 2 Players Slam NC Over “Pay-To-Win” Update
content:
NC has been walking the fine line between free-to-play and pay-to-win with Aion 2 ever since the game’s global launch on October 5, but with today’s update, the game might just have crossed it.

At its core, Aion 2 is a free-to-play (F2P) game since the MMORPG is literally free on Steam. However, players have repeatedly raised concerns about the F2P experience being borderline “unplayable” due to the quality-of-life bonuses you can get upon purchasing a subscription.

Up until today, getting an Aion 2 subscription mostly sped up your progress, and no major progression was locked behind a paywall. The November 24 update changes that by adding a crucial progression feature to the “Wind Breeze Merchants” shop, a vendor available exclusively to subscribers.

For the unaware, today’s Aion 2 update unlocked the 5th Stigma slot for players. Players can use the extra Stigma slot for their characters by obtaining Stigma Shards in-game. To help players level up their newly added Stigma slot, this update also adds a total of 50 Stigma Shards that are obtainable through various means.

This is where the pay-to-win criticism comes in. Of those 50 Stigma Shards, 20 are locked behind the sub-only shop, meaning F2P players have no way to obtain them. For reference, 20 shards are enough to take a Stigma skill from level 0 all the way up to level 11 , with the max level of each skill being 20.

Shortly after the patch notes were revealed to the public, posts began surfacing on social media regarding NC’s decision to lock the Stigma Shards behind the sub-only shop.

title: Esports World Cup : Counter-Strike 2 rempile jusqu’en 2028
content:

Devenu l’un des rendez-vous majeurs du calendrier international de Counter-Strike, l’événement permet chaque année aux meilleures formations mondiales de se mesurer à des équipes moins prestigieuses, notamment grâce au Last Chance Qualifier.

L’édition 2026, organisée à Paris, avait d’ailleurs parfaitement illustré cette particularité. title: CS2 Returns to the Esports World Cup in 2027 and 2028, With $700,000 for the Riyadh Champions
content:
Counter-Strike 2 is staying at the Esports World Cup for at least two more years. The Esports Foundation confirmed on 25 November that CS2 will return for EWC 2027 and EWC 2028 , which makes Valve’s shooter a fixture at the event for five straight years. More importantly for the teams, the 2027 edition comes with a firm date, a $2 million prize pool and a qualification system that rewards consistency across the whole first half of the season.

The tournament heads back to Esports Boulevard in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, after the 2026 finals were staged at the Accor Arena in Paris. It runs from 20 July to 1 August 2027 with 32 teams, while the 2028 edition is pencilled in for 14 to 30 July 2028. The organisers have not yet given a venue, format or prize pool for that second year, so for now 2027 is where the detail lies.

Every stage of the 2027 event is played in person, qualifier included. Stage 1 splits the 32 teams into four groups of eight, each run as a double-elimination bracket, and the top four from every group move on. The 16 survivors then meet in a Stage 2 playoff played as best-of-threes, with only the grand final stretched to a best-of-five. In practice, that means a team can afford one bad series in the groups but not two, which tends to favour deep, experienced rosters over hot streaks.

The money is weighted heavily towards the top. The champions take home $700,000, or roughly a third of the pool, while second place is worth $300,000, third $150,000 and fourth $90,000. Even so, nobody leaves empty-handed, since every team in the main event collects at least $10,000. The full payout table and schedule are on the official EWC 2027 Counter-Strike 2 page .

Most of the field is built from the Valve Regional Standings . Twenty places go to the best-ranked teams in the global standings, and North America, South America and Asia each get two more invites of their own, which guarantees those regions a presence however the global table looks. Two wildcard invites complete the direct list. Crucially, invitations follow the first monthly VRS publication of May 2027, and seeding uses the first ranking published in July. As a result, the first five months of next year effectively become the qualifier for most of the teams that will travel to Riyadh.

The last four places come from the Riyadh Open Qualifier on 16 to 18 July 2027, and this is where the format changes most. At EWC 2026, the final four spots went through a 64-team Last Chance Qualifier. Next year’s open qualifier allows up to 128 teams on a first-come, first-served basis, with a $100 entry fee and $100,000 shared among the teams that finish fifth to 16th. The entry fee is trivial, although the in-person, non-BYOC format means flights and hotels in Riyadh will be the real cost for any team chasing one of those four slots. Registration details have not been announced yet.

title: Solary : Sakor pousse un coup de gueule contre « le copinage » en LEC
content:
Malgré les excellentes performances de Solary et de Galions sur la scène européenne cette année, seuls cinq joueurs issus de ces deux formations devraient évoluer en LEC en 2027 : HARPOON, Thayger, Kryze, Zicssi et Piero. Un constat particulièrement frustrant pour Sakor Ros, qui estime que les dix joueurs méritaient leur chance dans l’élite européenne. Interrogé notamment sur l’absence de Zoelys, le cofondateur de Solary n’a pas mâché ses mots, dans des propos relayés par aAa . « Je pense que les dix ont leur place pour remplacer des joueurs en LEC, parce que la ligue est trop un cercle fermé de joueurs qui sont là depuis longtemps, donc on les fait tourner. »

Sakor regrette notamment que certaines organisations continuent de miser sur des joueurs expérimentés en raison de leurs succès passés, prenant l’exemple de Matyáš « Carzzy » Orság, attendu chez Movistar KOI après son départ de Vitality. Le dirigeant tourangeau dénonce plus globalement le manque d’ambition et de scouting de certaines structures européennes. « C’est ça aussi le problème du LEC : c’est du copinage. Tu as plein d’équipes qui sont là sans ambition, donc elles ne vont pas essayer d’aller scouter de nouveaux profils. Elles vont juste prendre des noms pour des noms sans les avoir vus jouer. »

Mais c’est surtout le retour pressenti de Mihael « Mikyx » Mehle chez G2 Esports qui fait bondir Sakor. Malgré l’immense palmarès du support slovène et ses précédents succès aux côtés de Hans sama, le cofondateur de Solary estime que les Samouraïs auraient dû se tourner vers un profil plus jeune. « Mikyx, je suis désolé, Mikyx qui revient chez G2, c’est de la merde. Voilà, c’est ridicule. Pour moi, il ne devrait plus être en LEC » , a-t-il lâché, regrettant également le recrutement de Skeanz par SK Gaming lors de la précédente intersaison.

Pour Sakor, G2 aurait notamment pu donner sa chance à Piero ou à Zoelys, dont il apprécie particulièrement les qualités en phase de lane. « Le prime de Mikyx est passé. Moi, je n’aurais pas trouvé ça déconnant de prendre un autre support, genre justement un G2 qui va chercher un Piero, ou même un Zoelys. Je pense que ça aurait pu fonctionner. » Au-delà du cas de Mikyx, cette sortie médiatique relance le débat sur les passerelles entre les ligues régionales et le LEC, alors que de nombreux talents continuent de se heurter aux portes de l’élite européenne malgré leurs performances en ERL.

title: Krimbo after NIP’s 3-0: “I have to say, Kacper, chill”
content:
The NIP in-game leader credits the coaching staff’s preparation and a calmer team for a perfect run through Stage 1.

Obviously, these first days yesterday, the best of one day, it’s always the scariest, right? Because not always the best team wins.

Asked about the team’s composure after two tight wins on day one and the sweep of Liquid, Krimbo pointed to how the communication has changed since the roster came together.

I think we are way more, way cooler in heated situations and also calm the comms more down, which was in the beginning not the case at all because we were just, we don’t really knew each other, right? Everyone’s just shouting around information. No one really knows what’s going on.

He added that part of his job is to slow down xKacpersky : “I also have to say, Kacper, chill, you know, because he just wants to run around sometimes.”

title: CS2 skin market loses 8% of its value in a week
content:
The total value of CS2 skins has dropped day after day this week.

The CS2 skin market was worth $4.74 billion on the morning of 25 November, 8.1% less than a week earlier, according to the price tracker CSMarketCap . Its daily figures show a steady fall through the week.

Selling into a falling market costs fees too. We compare what the best CS2 skin sites charge and how they pay out.

The slide is part of a longer trend. CSMarketCap puts the market 13.2% lower than a month ago, 25.5% lower over 90 days and 40.9% below where it was a year ago. At its all-time high it was worth $8.71 billion.

Pricempire , which counts the market differently and values it at $5.20 billion, shows the same direction. Its fear and greed index stood at 31, in the “fear” zone.

The fall comes as 772 Singapore Major items, from stickers and capsules to souvenir packages, have joined the market since 17 November. Sticker sales for this Major were already trailing Cologne’s , according to SAW’s manager.

title: PUBG Mobile 4.7 Patch Notes: M134 and Flamethrower Buffed as Two Pending Bugs Are Finally Fixed
content:
PUBG Mobile has rolled out another round of fixes for its 4.7 Arctic Chronicles update, buffing two Metro Royale weapons against monsters and clearing two bugs it had flagged as pending for almost a week. The development team listed 15 changes in its latest notice on 24 November, covering the Arctic Chronicles mode, World of Wonder, Metro Royale and the lobby. It is the fourth fix list since version 4.7 went live on 12 November, following earlier rounds on 16, 18 and 20 November.

The change most players will notice is in Metro Royale, where the M134 and the Flamethrower now deal more damage to monsters. The rest of the list is mostly clean-up, from characters clipping into the Ancient Beast in the Prison area to the blurry graphics some players saw after the patch. PUBG Mobile did not say whether any of the changes need a new download, and its notice asks players to report remaining issues through customer service or its official community.

PUBG Mobile grouped the changes by mode, and the list below follows the same order. Arctic Chronicles, the themed mode at the heart of version 4.7, received three fixes. Metro Royale had the longest section, with six changes including the weapon buff, while five general fixes cover finishes, events and the lobby.

Dear players, Thanks to your proactive feedback, we have recently resolved the following issues: Arctic Chronicles – Fixed a terrain display issue in certain areas. – Fixed a display issue with the portal tunnel visual effect after entering a portal. – Fixed an issue in the…

PUBG Mobile’s fix notices have carried a Pending Fix section since 18 November, and this round clears two of its oldest entries. The incomplete U-CH0 medal description and the S32 P90 icon that did not match its in-match colour were both listed as pending in the 18 November notice . Both were still waiting in the 20 November notice , which did fix a third item from that list, the held weapon finish displaying wrongly when players returned to the Metro Royale lobby.

One problem from the 18 November list has not yet appeared as fixed. Metro Royale containers that showed two Honors, only one of which could be picked up, were listed as pending at the time, and neither of the two later notices mentions them. Players who still run into it can report it, because PUBG Mobile keeps pointing players to its customer service and official community channels for feedback.

title: GTA 6’s ‘Woke’ Backlash Over Jason and Lucia Relationship
content:
The row over whether Grand Theft Auto VI has gone “woke” has spilled out of streams and X threads and into mainstream news. AFP’s wire story on 25 November asked whether the series had gone soft . CBC News then reported that some streamers find the game too woke , while WIRED ran a piece on 19 November about men online who are angry that the game rewards being a good partner. The complaints centre on Jason and Lucia’s relationship, a new system that scores how players behave, and the absence of sex workers for the first time since GTA III.

The backlash sits awkwardly next to the numbers. GTA VI made about .8 billion on its first day, as our report on its record launch revenue covers, and it holds a 99 Metascore, as our reviews roundup found. That gap between the loudest critics and the wider audience is exactly what has drawn reporters in.

Most of the anger is about what the game asks players to do between heists. Players are encouraged to look after the relationship by fixing up Jason and Lucia’s house, buying flowers and jewellery, and running errands such as picking up groceries for Lucia. Some anonymous X users have called the result “feminist slop”, while others have reached for a slur borrowed from manosphere forums, according to AFP. Several streamers have also complained that too much of the early story is made up of errand-style missions.

The second target is the behaviour system, which AFP describes as an honour system. Citing video game press reports, the agency said players earn focus and behaviour points for acts such as kindness to strangers, not littering and staying fit. The happiest ending reportedly needs a strong relationship and a professional criminal profile rather than a violent or psycho one, which critics argue is a strange fit for a series built on chaos.

Fans who miss the older games also point to the removal of sex workers, a feature the series had carried since GTA III in 2001, as our report on why Rockstar removed it explains. For many of the angriest players, that single change has become a symbol of everything they think the series has lost. Others simply argue that the game has become less of a sandbox and more of a guided story.

Rockstar has framed the changes as a matter of story. The studio told AFP that GTA VI is about a couple in trouble and on the run together, and that its design choices were made to serve that story. Rockstar North’s Rob Nelson made a similar point before launch, saying the game offers optional ways to show empathy for players who want them, as our report on his comments and the criminal profile explains.

title: Woman Asks Instagram How to Cash Out Her Boyfriend’s CS2 Skins, Gets Roasted Instead
content:
A screenshot of a woman asking Instagram how to cash out her boyfriend’s Counter-Strike 2 skins while he was away from his PC has gone viral, and every reply shown in the screenshot turned on her. The post shows a monitor filled with knives, gloves and rifle skins, alongside a request for help selling them because he would not do it himself. The caption says she wanted the money for a visit to a cosmetologist, which only made the reaction harsher.

The screenshot spread fast after a CS2 meme account shared it on X on 24 November. Much of the attention has come from the comments, and from the reminder of how much some CS2 inventories are now worth. It also raises a fair question that the replies mostly skipped over, which is whether anyone could actually do what she asked.

In the post, the woman says she has access to her boyfriend’s PC and asks how to cash out the items on the screen. She adds that he refuses to do it himself, and that she wants the money for a beauty appointment. The inventory in the photo is the kind that many CS2 players spend years building, with several knives and pairs of gloves sitting in the top rows.

The most popular reply told her to look after her partner’s things and “mind your own business”, and it drew thousands of likes. Another joked that if he found out, no cosmetologist would be able to help her. A third pointed out that turning skins into real money is far more of a hassle than she seemed to think, and advised her to leave them alone.

A girl tried to cash out her boyfriend’s skins while he wasn’t at his PC and asked for help on Instagram. Comments cooked her instantly pic.twitter.com/LSDaHnrZzV

There is no way to confirm that the post is genuine, and the account that first posted it is not visible in the screenshot. The text also reads like a translation, so it may have started in another language before it reached X. Viral posts like this one are often jokes or bait, and it should be treated as an unverified screenshot rather than a real attempt to empty someone’s account.

title: BGMI Air vs BGMI on the Same Phone: 60 FPS vs 40, Zero Ads and No 2.4GB Download
content:
BGMI Air’s open beta went live on the Google Play Store at 10am IST on 25 November, and by lunchtime X was full of posts claiming that the lighter version of Battlegrounds Mobile India lags badly and pushes ads at players. We installed it the same morning and played a full Classic match on Erangel to see how much of that holds up. Across roughly 14 minutes of recorded play, the ping readout never moved from 20ms, not a single ad appeared, and the game let us drop into a 100-player match without forcing any extra download first.

One phone and one match cannot settle the question for every device, of course, and Air makes some visible trade-offs to stay this small. To put the numbers in context, we then installed the main BGMI on the same phone, signed in with the same account and played it too. Below is everything we found, set against what KRAFTON has confirmed so far and what other early testers are reporting.

The lag complaints were the main reason we wanted to test Air ourselves, so we kept an eye on the network readout in the bottom corner of the screen throughout. From the plane and the drop towards Georgopol, through a buggy ride across the map, to a firefight in which we knocked down an enemy, it read 20ms every time we checked, on Wi-Fi and on the India server. Going back through the recording afterwards, we found no rubber-banding and no frozen frames either.

Smoothness held up just as well. Our screen recording averaged about 58 frames per second over the session, which suggests the game was running close to 60 FPS for most of the match. A screen recorder is not a proper frame counter, so treat that figure as a strong hint rather than a benchmark. It is also worth saying that our test phone runs the main game too, which means this result tells you little about how Air behaves on a 2GB budget handset, the kind of device it was actually built for. That test is next on our list.

The ad worry appears to trace back to an Instagram story from the creator LetsGrow about irrelevant ads playing while the lobby sat idle, according to the esports account Esports360 (@Esports360igc). Esports360 then tried it in both BGMI and BGMI Air, leaving each game idle in the lobby for five to six minutes, and reported that no ad appeared in either.

Our session lines up with that. We spent time in the lobby, opened the Download Center, waited through matchmaking on the spawn island and played the match out, and at no point did a video or banner ad show up. Live service games can switch features on from the server whenever the developer chooses, so that could change before or after launch, but on the evidence so far the ad claims look unproven.

title: FACEIT add free scrims for CS2 teams from 9 December
content:
Teams that paid to find and host practice matches get a free option on FACEIT’s own servers.

FACEIT will open Scrims, a free practice system for teams, to all CS2 players on 9 December with the start of Season 10. It runs on FACEIT’s servers and anti-cheat, nothing is charged, and no Elo is at stake. North American ESEA League teams already have it in beta.

Introducing FACEIT Scrims, a free team practice system on FACEIT's Anti-Cheat with no Elo at risk, in beta for North American League teams first. Post your times and maps, challenge a team, and ready up. Live for all players December 09 with Season 10: https://t.co/qfvOsqDKau pic.twitter.com/Akek6TmrHF

It works like a noticeboard rather than a queue, according to FACEIT’s Scrims FAQ . A team captain posts maps, servers, the format and up to six possible times. Other teams pick a slot and one of the host’s maps, there is no veto, and the captain accepts the request they want. At the agreed time all ten players get a ready-up prompt, and if anyone misses it, the scrim is cancelled. Teams need a five-player lineup, and only the captain can post or accept.

The directory shows scrims in your region and can be filtered by maps, servers, ESEA League group and the other team’s average Elo. Every scrim also has a share link, so teams that already know each other can skip the directory.

Public scrims put the stats and demo on players’ profiles. An ESEA League Pass on at least one player unlocks private scrims, games where every round is played instead of stopping at 13, a single chosen server (free teams must offer at least three) and more open requests than the 10 a free team gets.

title: s1mple on his road back: “You start a new game without saving”
content:
The GOSH star calls the last years “very hard” and says playing in front of a crowd is now why he plays.

s1mple says his return to the top has felt like starting over, in an interview shown on the PGL broadcast between maps of GOSH’s elimination match against Chinggis Warriors at the PGL Major Singapore 2026 . It is his first Major since Austin, and his first with Counter-Strike 2 stickers of his own.

It’s hard, I will tell you honestly, it’s very hard. It feels like a rollback. You start a new game without saving.

He added that things are “much better now, especially with the team”.

Asked whether the player who wanted to win everything is still there, s1mple said the hunger for wins has not changed, but something else matters more now.

My motivation is the same for winning. But I think it’s the most important for me to feel stage again. That’s why I’m playing, because I want to play on stage, I want to play in front of fans, in front of crowd. And this adrenaline gives you more motivation.

title: jks on FlyQuest’s 3-0 run: “I may as well go as hard as I can”
content:
The Australian says he stopped trying to be someone he is not, and that aliStair has calmed a team that used to talk over itself.

jks says he has found his own game again at FlyQuest , minutes after the Australians beat Imperial 2-0 to finish Stage 1 of the PGL Major Singapore 2026 unbeaten. Speaking on the PGL broadcast, he explained what has changed, why aliStair’s calling has settled the team, and why he is in no mood to slow down.

FlyQuest came from 2-5 and 7-10 down to take Imperial’s Dust2 13-11, then won ten of the last 12 rounds on Cache. jks finished the series with 36 kills and 25 deaths and a 1.34 rating, the best on the server.

Asked why he looks closer to the player he was at 100 Thieves, jks pointed first to what happens in the server.

With these guys it’s really easy to have my own space, call what I want to call and suggest things mid-round. They let me be who I want to be in the server.

He added that the rest is confidence: “just kind of remembering who I am and playing my comfort zones, not trying to be someone who I’m not, which I feel like maybe on some of my past teams I have been a little bit.”

title: BGMI Air Supported Devices: Minimum Requirements and Phones That Can Run It
content:
BGMI Air needs only 1.5GB of RAM and an Adreno 306 GPU or better to run on Android, which puts it within reach of phones that cannot handle the full version of Battlegrounds Mobile India. On iPhone and iPad, you need iOS 13 or later.

KRAFTON India built BGMI Air for players with entry level phones and limited storage, and the game launches on 10 December 2026. This guide lists the confirmed BGMI Air requirements, which phones are likely to qualify and how you can check your own device before launch.

KRAFTON has confirmed two hardware requirements for Android: at least 1.5GB of RAM and an Adreno 306 GPU or higher. It has not announced a minimum Android version. For Apple devices, the App Store listing specifies iOS 13 or later.

Compare that with the full BGMI, which now takes well over 10GB on many phones once all resource packs are downloaded. BGMI Air starts at around 1GB on Android, and extra content packs are optional, so you can remove them if your storage runs low.

KRAFTON has not released an official list of supported phones. Any Android phone that meets both requirements, 1.5GB of RAM and an Adreno 306 or newer GPU, should be able to install and run the game.

title: Apex Legends Cheaters Stayed in Matches for Up to 4 Hours
content:
Respawn says its new EA Javelin anti-cheat bans 51% more Apex Legends cheaters than Easy Anti-Cheat did. The studio also admitted that detected cheaters could keep playing for up to four hours before a ban landed.

Respawn says its new EA Javelin anti-cheat bans 51% more Apex Legends cheaters than Easy Anti-Cheat did. The studio also admitted that detected cheaters could keep playing for up to four hours before a ban landed.

The admission came in a two-month review of Javelin, which took over PC anti-cheat duties at the end of September. Respawn says a new enforcement system, live this week, has cut the wait between detection and ban to as little as one match.

Javelin is built by a team inside Electronic Arts, which gives Respawn a direct line to the engineers who maintain it. The studio says that speeds up investigations and its response to new cheats, and it backs legal action against cheat makers and sellers, including cease-and-desist notices.

The system runs at the kernel level, so it sees deeper into a player's machine. Respawn says that helps against malicious or vulnerable drivers, virtualization, unauthorized controller hardware and software, and DMA (direct memory access) devices.

The rollout was cautious. Several lower-level protections were switched off at launch and enabled gradually as the team grew confident in their stability. An issue hit the EA App shortly after launch and was fixed the next day.

title: Team Apex Gaming’s New BGMI Roster Will Feature OG Players, Hints Jonathan

He described them as OG members of the community but refrained from revealing any names. “You can say these are the OGs. They’re the OG members of the community, and I can’t reveal anything right now.”

Jonathan has not revealed the names of the players who will be joining Team Apex Gaming’s BGMI roster. Fans will have to wait for an official announcement from the organisation for further details.

title: LEC : Daglas, dernière recrue côté Shifters ?
content:
Le mercato du LEC touche à sa fin ! Selon les informations de Sheep Esports , Kacper « Daglas » Dagiel aurait trouvé un accord avec Shifters pour la saison 2027. Le jungler polonais de 21 ans n’était pourtant pas le premier choix de l’organisation suisse, qui avait notamment formulé une offre à ISMA et manifesté son intérêt pour Sheo, finalement recruté par Vitality. Alors qu’il avait déjà trouvé un accord avec une formation du championnat polonais, Daglas devrait donc poursuivre sa carrière au plus haut niveau européen.

Il s’agira de sa troisième expérience en LEC, après ses passages chez Vitality et Team Heretics. Lancé dans le grand bain en 2023 pour remplacer Bo chez les Abeilles, Daglas avait notamment décroché une quatrième place lors du Spring Split 2024 avant d’être écarté de l’effectif. Redescendu dans les ligues régionales, le Polonais avait ensuite disputé deux finales des EMEA Masters, sans parvenir à soulever le trophée. Promu chez Heretics au printemps dernier pour remplacer Sheo, il n’avait malheureusement pas réussi à redresser la barre, terminant dixième du Spring Split puis neuvième du Summer Split.

Initialement désireuse de mettre son slot en location pour la saison 2027, Shifters a dû reconstruire intégralement son effectif en quelques jours, alors que la grande majorité des équipes européennes avaient déjà bouclé leur recrutement. Avec l’arrivée de Daglas, la structure suisse devrait finalement aligner un cinq composé d’Adam, Daglas, Kamiloo, SamD et Fleshy, sous les ordres d’Edward, ancien support emblématique de Moscow Five et Gambit Gaming, reconverti dans le coaching.

Si Shifters ne partira évidemment pas parmi les favoris du LEC en 2027, cette nouvelle formation dispose de plusieurs joueurs désireux de relancer leur carrière et de prouver leur valeur dans l’élite. Pour Daglas, cette troisième opportunité sera surtout l’occasion de s’installer durablement au plus haut niveau. Son recrutement marque également la fin du mercato des joueurs titulaires en LEC, puisque les 50 places seraient désormais pourvues. Seuls quelques dossiers concernant les coaching staffs resteraient encore à finaliser avant la reprise de la compétition.

title: MrBeast Gaming Overtakes IShowSpeed as GTA 6 Launch Week Views Hit 1.77 Billion
content:
MrBeast Gaming has overtaken IShowSpeed as the YouTube channel gaining the most views from Grand Theft Auto VI’s launch week. MrBeast’s gaming channel had added 269.9 million public views by 25 November, against 232.9 million for IShowSpeed, according to PUNKSQUAD’s GTA VI launch tracker . Speed led comfortably for the first few days, but a huge two-day surge early this week carried MrBeast Gaming past him.

The tracker follows 127 channels streaming the game, and together they have picked up 1.77 billion public views since 18 November, the day before launch. Those channels have a combined 1.15 billion subscribers, which gives a sense of how far GTA VI has spread across YouTube in a single week. The surge on YouTube follows a record on Twitch as well, as our report on the game’s 7.1 million peak viewers at launch covers.

IShowSpeed made the much faster start of the two. His channel added 37.4 million views in the first daily snapshot after launch and another 61.3 million in the next, so he was close to 100 million before MrBeast Gaming had reached 30 million. By the snapshot on 22 November, Speed still led by 138.7 million to 94.7 million.

The gap then closed in just two days. MrBeast Gaming added 74.7 million views in the 23 November snapshot and 71.4 million in the next, the two biggest single-day gains of any channel on the list all week. That run took it from 94.7 million to 240.8 million and past Speed, who added 40.8 million and 35.4 million over the same two days.

The lead has kept growing since then, with 29.1 million more views for MrBeast Gaming in the 25 November snapshot against 18.0 million for Speed. MrBeast Gaming is the gaming offshoot of MrBeast, whose main channel is the most subscribed on YouTube. It now has 62.8 million subscribers of its own, almost level with Speed’s 63.3 million. The main channel has been setting records of its own this year too, as our report on his record-breaking grocery store challenge shows.

Techno Gamerz sits third with 112.2 million, well clear of a tight group below him. IGN’s channel is fourth on 76.8 million, just ahead of Kai Cenat Live on 72.5 million, while DarkViperAU , best known for his GTA V speedruns and commentary, is sixth with 69.4 million. Kai Cenat’s GTA streams have made headlines of their own this month, as our report on his GTA marathon sets out.

title: That Leaked GTA 6 Online Press Release Is Fake, and It Admits It in the Last Line
content:
A document dressed up as an official Rockstar Games press release for GTA VI’s online mode is spreading on X, claiming that it launches in March 2027 on every platform, PC included. The document is not a real Rockstar release. Rockstar has published no such announcement on its Newswire , and the document’s own closing line admits that “Rockstar Games has not announced a date for GTA VI Online”.

The image was posted on 24 November by an X account created in July 2026, which said it found the document “2 months before Rockstar planned to announce it”. The same post said “i was using Fable”, the name of an AI model, and the footer of the image reads “by Fable 5.2”. Earlier posts from the account claimed to have replaced Rockstar’s entire QA team with the same AI model, which tells you most of what you need to know about where this came from.

official GTA 6 Online launch date just leaked. March 2027, every platform, PC from day one. Rockstar is putting $780 million into it before it even goes live i found this 2 months before Rockstar planned to announce it. they tried to get it taken down twice. i was using Fable… pic.twitter.com/oCbBgrVuEr

Real press releases announce things, but this one argues with itself. Its headline says Rockstar “Announces Grand Theft Auto Online for Grand Theft Auto VI Now Available”, its dateline reads March 2027, and its first paragraph says the mode “is now live”. Yet it appeared online in November 2026, and it ends by saying no date has been announced at all.

The structure of the document gives it away even faster. It includes sections titled “Why This Window” and “What Rockstar Still Has to Solve Before Launch”, which list server stability, a missing 60fps mode and single-player bugs as open problems. No publisher lists its own unresolved worries in a launch announcement, and none cites news reports and analyst estimates as its sources, which this document does throughout.

The numbers in it do not hold up to a basic check either. Its table puts Take-Two’s guidance for the 2027 financial year at $8.08 billion to $8.28 billion in net bookings, but Take-Two’s earnings release on 9 November reiterated $8.0 billion to $8.2 billion. It also cites 9.69 million pre-orders, an early-November Sensor Tower estimate that later counts overtook, as our report on that figure covered.

title: BGMI Air FPS: How Much FPS Does BGMI Air Support? All 7 Frame Rate Options Explained
content:
BGMI Air is KRAFTON India’s lighter version of Battlegrounds Mobile India, built to run on budget phones with less storage and memory. For many players, the first question is how smooth it can run, because frame rate decides how responsive aiming, recoil control and movement feel in a fight.

The answer depends on your phone. BGMI Air keeps the same frame rate ladder as the main game, but which options you can select is decided by your device’s chipset, RAM and display refresh rate.

BGMI Air lists frame rate options from 20 FPS up to 120 FPS. Its Frame Rate Settings menu shows seven levels: Power Saving, Medium, High, Ultra, Extreme, Extreme+ and Ultra Extreme. On most budget and mid range phones, the highest option available is Extreme, which runs the game at 60 FPS.

The two highest settings, Extreme+ (90 FPS) and Ultra Extreme (120 FPS), appear greyed out on phones that do not support them. These options only unlock on devices with a high refresh rate display and a chipset strong enough to hold that frame rate, the same rule KRAFTON India applies in the main game.

Each frame rate level in BGMI Air matches a target number of frames per second. Higher settings feel smoother but use more battery and produce more heat.

The lowest setting caps the game at 20 FPS. It is meant for very old phones or for saving battery, but the low frame rate makes fast fights and aiming noticeably harder.

title: Fake GTA 6 PC Downloads Are Spreading Malware After the Biggest Port Project Vanished
content:
The biggest effort to turn the leaked Xbox build of Grand Theft Auto VI into a playable PC game has gone offline, and the scammers are filling the gap. Project Leonida’s GitHub page and Discord server both disappeared late on 23 November, US time, only hours after Cyberleek released the build’s missing executable. Security researchers have warned for months that fake GTA VI downloads are a favourite way to spread malware. With the best-known port project gone, those fakes are now the bigger risk for anyone hunting for a PC version.

None of the PC port efforts was ever an official release, and Rockstar Games still has not announced a PC version of the game. Our report on the first PC port claims covered how far the modders said they had got. Since then, the story has shifted from what the leaked build can do to what downloading it can do to your computer.

Leonida was an open-source effort to rebuild the leaked Xbox code so that it would run natively on Windows. Before it went offline, its GitHub repository had more than 34,000 stars, over 400 contributors and more than 3,000 copies made by other users. Late on 23 November, Eastern time, the repository moved to a new account and then stopped loading altogether, and the project’s main Discord server, with around 179,000 members, vanished soon afterwards.

The project’s creator posted a short message on X shortly after the shutdown: “I quit guys. I’m sorry.” He has said that Rockstar was behind the removal of the Discord server, but Rockstar, Take-Two Interactive and Discord have not commented publicly. GitHub publishes the copyright notices it receives in a public DMCA archive , and no notice against Leonida had appeared there at the time of reporting, so it is still not confirmed who removed the repository.

Take-Two does have a long record of using copyright takedowns against unofficial versions of its games, including hundreds of unofficial GTA V mobile ports on GitHub in the run-up to GTA VI’s launch. It has also used US court subpoenas against Microsoft and Discord this year in its hunt for Cyberleek, as our explainer on the leaker sets out. Chief executive Strauss Zelnick said before launch that the company expected the game to be pirated, as our report on his comments covered.

The fakes are not new, but the leak has given them a fresh hook. Security firm Huntress found in September that one fake GTA 6 installer showed a “license not found” message to make victims think the game had simply failed to install. In the background, it dropped remote access tools, a stealer for passwords and Discord tokens, and a ransomware strain that Huntress said behaved like a wiper, destroying files rather than holding them for ransom.

title: GTA 6 Runs Smoother on Xbox Series X Than PS5, PS5 Pro the Best
content:
Grand Theft Auto VI runs more smoothly on Xbox Series X than on a standard PS5, according to Digital Foundry’s comparison of every console version. The two consoles share the same core settings and a very similar image, but the PS5 drops more frames, particularly when players are driving at speed through Vice City. The best version of all is on PS5 Pro, while the Xbox Series S is the one Digital Foundry found hardest to recommend.

The result has drawn attention because Sony has been the face of the game’s marketing, and PlayStation has called GTA VI the biggest launch in its history. More than 39 million players have played it on PS5 since launch, as our PlayStation launch record report covers, so the base console’s performance matters to a huge audience. Every version targets 30 frames per second, as our report on the Xbox 60fps glitch explains, so small dips below that target are easy to feel.

Digital Foundry found that the Xbox Series X and the base PS5 both output a softer image at around 1440p, with matching key settings. In some areas the Series X has small resolution advantages and slightly higher-quality visuals, though it also shows occasional blurriness and some missing shadows. Overall, Digital Foundry said the game “acquits itself quite well” on Microsoft’s most powerful console.

The bigger difference is in frame rate rather than image quality. “In typical play, both of them hit 30 FPS or don’t fall far below,” Digital Foundry said, but the PS5 dips more often than its rival. During fast driving, Digital Foundry said, “PS5 seems substantially worse off in this respect”, although chases and explosions can still pull the Series X below its target too.

That gap will surprise many players, since PlayStation has handled much of the game’s marketing. It is also a reminder that the two machines are close in power, and that small differences in how a game handles heavy scenes can decide which version feels steadier. On paper, the Series X has the stronger graphics chip, rated at about 12 teraflops against roughly 10.3 for the PS5, while the PS5 has the faster storage drive. Busy driving sequences lean heavily on the graphics chip, which may help explain where the Xbox pulls ahead. Rockstar has already released updates since launch, as our guide to update 01.002.002 covers, and future patches could narrow the difference.

The PS5 Pro version stands clear of the rest. Digital Foundry described its image as “4K-like”, with solid frame rates and ray-traced shadows that give a noticeable upgrade over the other consoles. It called the Pro version “the best option available”, which will reassure players who bought Sony’s most expensive console with this game in mind. The Pro launched in November 2024 as Sony’s upgraded PS5, with a stronger graphics chip and better ray tracing, and GTA VI is exactly the kind of game it was built to show off.

title: LCK : Deft raconte comment il a préparé son retour pendant son service militaire

À 30 ans, Kim « Deft » Hyeok-gyu n’en a pas encore terminé avec League of Legends. Battu lors des qualifications régionales pour les Worlds 2024, le légendaire ADC sud-coréen refusait de voir cette défaite devenir le dernier match de sa carrière. Durant son service militaire obligatoire, il a donc tout mis en œuvre pour rester au niveau. Dans un entretien accordé à Xportsnews , Deft a notamment révélé avoir loué un appartement à proximité de sa base militaire pour pouvoir continuer à s’entraîner durant ses permissions. « Je sortais environ trois fois par mois pour m’entraîner. Je savais qu’il serait difficile de rattraper mon retard si je décrochais au niveau des patchs ou de l’évolution de la méta. »

Le champion du monde 2022 a également continué à suivre attentivement les compétitions, étudiant les performances des nouveaux talents et échangeant régulièrement avec d’autres joueurs professionnels. À une centaine de jours de la fin de son service militaire, plusieurs organisations ont commencé à se manifester. Nongshim RedForce a toutefois été la première à le contacter, son directeur général allant jusqu’à lui envoyer une lettre directement à sa base militaire. Touché par cette marque de confiance et convaincu par le potentiel de joueurs comme Kingen et Calix, Deft a finalement choisi de rejoindre la structure sud-coréenne.

Chez Nongshim RedForce, Deft retrouvera deux anciens coéquipiers avec lesquels il avait décroché le titre mondial en 2022 sous les couleurs de DRX, Kingen et Pyosik. Malgré cinq années sans participation aux playoffs pour l’organisation, le vétéran affiche de grandes ambitions. « Je pense qu’une équipe progresse le plus lorsqu’elle participe à des compétitions internationales. Je veux donc me qualifier pour les championnats du monde et y créer de beaux souvenirs » , a-t-il confié dans un entretien publié par son nouveau club. L’ADC espère également contribuer à changer l’image de Nongshim, comme avait pu le faire Peanut par le passé.

Deft refuse toutefois de faire de son retour après le service militaire une excuse en cas de difficultés. Conscient des interrogations qui entourent son niveau après une si longue absence, le Sud-Coréen entend rapidement dissiper les doutes. « Mon objectif est que les fans se demandent, en me voyant jouer : ‘Est-ce qu’il vient vraiment de terminer son service militaire ?' » , a-t-il expliqué à Xportsnews . Plus ambitieux que jamais, Deft espère même afficher un meilleur niveau de jeu qu’avant son départ. À 30 ans, la légende sud-coréenne compte bien prouver qu’elle a encore de belles pages à écrire.

title: Krafton Earns ₹6,840 Crore in Q3 2026 as Profit Falls 35.5%, BGMI Air Crosses 14 Million Pre-Registrations
content:
Krafton earned ₩971.4 billion (about ₹6,840 crore or $728 million) in revenue in the third quarter of 2026, its latest results, up 11.6% from a year earlier. Operating profit fell 35.5% to ₩225 billion (about ₹1,584 crore or $169 million), and currency losses left the BGMI publisher with a net loss of ₩68.4 billion (about ₹482 crore or $51 million).

India featured prominently in the quarter, even though Krafton does not report revenue by country. The company pointed to BGMI Air’s pre-registration numbers on its earnings call, and Krafton India announced a fresh investment pledge that takes the group’s planned spending in the country past $500 million (about ₹4,700 crore).

Krafton reported the results on 10 November for the July to September quarter. Revenue rose from ₩870.6 billion (about ₹6,130 crore or $652 million) a year earlier, while operating profit fell mainly because of lower PC revenue and costs linked to gamescom.

Mobile remained Krafton’s largest business at ₩504.3 billion (about ₹3,551 crore or $378 million), up 3.2% year on year and 12% on the previous quarter. BGMI’s revenue sits inside this mobile figure, along with PUBG Mobile. PC revenue fell 32.5% to ₩238.9 billion (about ₹1,682 crore or $179 million), and console revenue was ₩8.6 billion (about ₹61 crore or $6.4 million).

Other revenue reached ₩219.6 billion (about ₹1,546 crore or $165 million), almost all of it from ₩198.4 billion (about ₹1,397 crore or $149 million) in advertising and content income from Japan’s ADK Group. A full breakdown of the quarter is in our report on Krafton’s Q3 2026 results .

Over the first nine months of 2026, Krafton posted record revenue of ₩3.633 trillion (about ₹25,581 crore or $2.72 billion), up 51%. Nine month operating profit reached ₩1.1975 trillion (about ₹8,432 crore or $897 million), up 14% and already above its full year profit for 2025.
